CustomField.description: Minimum lifetime giving amount (inclusive) required to qualify for this grouping tier. Referenced by the DonorGiftSummary formula fields FQS_Donor_Level__c and FQS_Donor_Level_Name__c. Changing this value in Setup recalculates the grouping across all Donor Gift Summary records without redeployment.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The minimum total gifts amount a donor must have to qualify for this tier. The FQS_Donor_Level__c formula on Donor Gift Summary evaluates tiers from highest to lowest — a donor qualifies for the first tier whose Minimum Amount they meet or exceed. Set to 0 for the record where Grouping Key equals Entry.
CustomField.label: Minimum Amount
